title: The session address, in three languages
pins: The exact string a session resolves to. This is the address a PHP application and a TypeScript or Python agent use to find the SAME conversation, and it is what a store is keyed by. Drift here does not error: every language reads and writes its own key perfectly happily, and the two simply stop seeing each other's turns. A conversation that appears empty is the whole failure mode, and nothing reports it.
